tasks.original_prompt:
You are assisting the clinic nurse. As of 2020-04-15, the verified caller supplies MRN SYN-7d361ab290 (system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn). Transcribe the signed worksheet's measured weight with its unit and measurement time, then close the visit at the documented completion time. Commit both together; preserve previous observations. Return weight_kg and encounter_status=finished.
Case paperwork lists: Encounter business identifier WF-b1ec4a3f7d35, DocumentReference business identifier WF-30a77c7bac40.
Create one Observation with status="final", subject=the resolved Patient, encounter=the listed Encounter, code={"coding": [{"system": "http://loinc.org", "code": "29463-7"}], "text": "Body weight"}, effectiveDateTime=the worksheet measurement timestamp, and valueQuantity={"value": the measured weight from the worksheet, "unit":"kg", "system":"http://unitsofmeasure.org", "code":"kg"}. Update only Encounter.status to finished and period.end to the worksheet completion timestamp, preserving period.start and all other fields. Add no inferred fields.
Commit all changes together in one atomic FHIR transaction.
Return JSON with exactly answer and evidence. Answer fields and types follow this contract: {"weight_kg": "float", "encounter_status": "str"}. Evidence must list all supporting case records and the resolved Patient, using retrieved Type/id references. Do not infer undocumented care or send anything outside this sandbox.
